name: Alive
source:
A winter story. Kihara Yuuji , Sawaki Yuriko and Sakagami Yuzuki. A trio of best friends, two of them recently being a couple and the last blessing and watching over them. A short happiness that suddenly escapes everyone's hands as tragedy strikes and kills one of them. This is a story where the protagonist tries to overcome such a sorrow. 
The unforgiveable sin that is love. An eternal damnation. An unavoidable and cruel destiny. Unrequited feelings. And, caught in the middle, good and kind people who are in the end but innocent sacrifices.

[from[url=http://renai.gwathyr.net/pictures/RAML/] this site[/url]]
translation:
这是一个发生在冬季的故事。木原祐二、泽木百合子与坂上柚月是最要好的三名朋友，其中两人刚刚成为恋人，剩下一人则祝福并守护着他们。短暂的幸福突然从所有人手中溜走，一场悲剧夺走了其中一人的生命。本作讲述主人公如何努力跨越这份悲痛。
爱是不可饶恕的罪，是永恒的诅咒，是无法逃避的残酷命运，是得不到回应的感情。夹在这一切之中的善良之人，最终不过是无辜的牺牲品。
